tools.name: about_site
tools.description: Describes The Aftermath (theaftermath.news): its mission, topics, post count, feeds and podcast shows.

tools.name: latest_news
tools.description: Lists the newest posts on theaftermath.news, newest first. Optional topic filters posts by tag (episodes are omitted when a topic is given).

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Searches theaftermath.news posts. Every query word of 3+ letters must match; title hits score 3, tag hits 2, excerpt and body hits 1 per word.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Returns one theaftermath.news post with its metadata and full text, looked up by slug or by URL. Bodies over 100,000 characters are truncated with a note.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_news, get_post · Public sink: about_site, get_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_news, get_post · Public sink: about_site, get_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
